verdict.rationale: ClickUp keeps work context in one shared workspace that several agents and tools can reach. Its official MCP server lets external AI agents read and act on tasks, lists, and docs. Brain² claims every model runs with full knowledge of your work, Super Agents take delegated tasks, and integrations sync GitHub and other tools with tasks. These are mostly marketing-level claims, and nothing documents an explicit handoff mechanism that carries state from one agent or tool to the next. Missing for 10: a documented agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff workflow, evidence that context or history is preserved across a handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: lets external AI agents interact with ClickUp Workspace data—like tasks, lists, folders, and docs—using natural language
